summary: M0 model-only verdict: MONITOR @ 1.00. prof.kaya@aegean.edu shows a consistent baseline: 10/11 successful logins from Portugal (Lisbon, MEO) via corporate VPN appliance vpn-edge-02 from known device LT-3104 across mail and LMS, matching the stated faculty-travelling-abroad + VPN context. The only outlier is a single successful mail login at 2026-10-15 06:40 from Manisa, Turkey (Turkcell mobile ASN) with no device_id, no VPN, and 0 MFA prompts — followed 32 minutes later by a Portugal VPN login, implying impossible travel and an unexplained auth. No mail events exist (no inbox/rule exposure). This is an isolated, weak, unexplained signal rather than confirmed takeover (no device takeover, no downstream mail activity, rest of session is consistent with the known device/VPN) and not fully benign (impossible travel/no device is not explained by travel alone). Evidence is sufficient to watch rather than escalate to a human immediately.
limitations: M0 ablation: Nemotron alone, no tools, no Critic, no Risk Gate, no DQ. Not a product configuration.
